verdict.rationale: Marketing copy claims 'AI-powered spend management' that automatically categorizes and controls transactions, and an 'Invoice Coding Agent' for automatic bill coding, which implies some AI-generated categorization/suggestions. However, there is no evidence of an actual insights dashboard, natural-language querying, anomaly detection, or proactive AI-generated suggestions surfaced to the end user within the product. Missing for 10: dedicated AI insights/analytics UI, examples of suggestion generation, independent/hands-on confirmation of these features working.
